en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a wide town square bordered by 3‑ to 4‑story historic buildings. A large tree and fenced sidewalk are on the left, with small shopfronts. In the middle distance there is a simple metal structure for overhead lines and a streetlamp. On the right stands a long, stately building with a central pedimented entrance facing the open square. A few figures and a carriage or cart are visible. The caption in red script at the bottom names the town and square, and a small publisher's line is printed at the lower left.
